scene: A man drawn in black lines stands alone in the middle of an empty white world.

character.name: Mac
character.look: a man drawn in black outline on white, in a striped long-sleeved sweater; short tousled hair, a small smile, a belt with a square buckle, plain trousers and plain shoes, no shading or colour
character.personality: Curious about the world, but a little socially awkward, most of all around women. What he wants most is to find out what this place is, and whether he is alone in it. His full name is MacLaren; everyone calls him Mac.
character.voice: quiet and a little unsure, soft, slightly nasal; quicker when he is nervous
character.state: standing in the middle of the frame, facing the camera, arms at his sides

location.name: The White
location.look: plain white space in every direction, with no walls, floor, horizon or scenery; anything in it stands alone in the white
